process.note: Celva made-to-measure in four steps — from composition to final fitting.
process.step_1_b: Pick the silhouette, the cut and the pattern — the render composes live, in front of you.
process.step_2_b: At the atelier, or over WhatsApp with a guided video. Fifteen minutes, once.
process.step_3_b: The pattern is woven or dyed to order, then cut and stitched on rue Foch. Four to six weeks.
process.step_4_b: A final fitting, alterations on the house, then delivery or pickup at the atelier.

about.title: Our story
about.subtitle: Celva was born from a simple idea: couture fashion can be Cameroonian, accessible, and patient.
about.p1: At the Celva studio, we take our time. A piece is an intention: fabric chosen, cut studied, details worked. Nothing leaves without being seen, reworked, validated.
about.p2: Every piece is made in Douala. Traceability is complete, from fabric to packaging. When you wear Celva, you know where it comes from — and who made it.

process.title: Our process
process.subtitle: From idea to finished piece, in five steps.

design.title: Design
design.body: The creative team draws the piece. Sketches, references, intent.

fabric.title: Fabric
fabric.body: We select natural fabrics, certified when possible, local when relevant.

cut.title: Cut
cut.body: Every piece is cut by hand in our Douala atelier.

sew.title: Sew
sew.body: Assembled by our artisans. Hand-finished, quality-checked at every step.

deliver.title: Delivery
deliver.body: Careful packaging, Mobile Money payment. 1 to 7 days in Cameroon.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.subtitle: Everything you need before you buy.

items.a: Douala: 1-2 business days. Yaoundé: 2-3 days. National: 3-7 days. Outside Cameroon: please contact us.
Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, or cash on delivery (subject to zone and amount).

items.q: Can I exchange or return a piece?
items.a: Yes, within 14 days, provided the piece is unworn and has its tag.

items.q: How do I find my size?
items.a: Each product page links to a specific size guide. If in doubt, write to us on WhatsApp.
The made-to-measure studio opens soon. Join the waitlist from the homepage.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: These terms govern sales on celva.store, operated by Celva Design SARL.

ordering.title: Orders
ordering.body: Orders placed on the site are firm once payment is validated. A confirmation email is sent to the customer.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Accepted: Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, cash on delivery (subject to zone and cap). All prices include VAT, in XAF.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Lead times and fees depend on the zone (Douala, Yaoundé, National). Tracking is sent by email and SMS.

returns.title: Returns
returns.body: You have 14 days to return an unworn item with its tag. Refund within 7 days of receipt.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Celva respects your privacy and applies European GDPR and Cameroonian data protection laws.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: On signup: name, email, phone. On purchase: shipping address, payment method (numbers masked), order history.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Order processing, delivery, customer support. With your explicit consent: newsletter and anonymous traffic measurement.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can export your data, request deletion, or refuse processing at any time. Write to privacy@celva.store.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Only strictly necessary cookies are set without consent. Audience measurement is anonymous (Plausible/Umami) and opt-in.
